description: Synthetic benchmark dataset for binary customer churn classification incorporating realistic business correlations and data flaws.

customer_age.description: Customer age in years (18 to 75). Incomplete profiles may record 0.

tenure_months.description: Number of months the customer has been active with the e-commerce platform.

monthly_spend.description: Average monthly expenditure by the customer in USD.

total_spend.description: Cumulative historical spend across customer lifetime.

login_frequency.description: Average number of portal / mobile app logins per month.

support_tickets.description: Number of customer support tickets raised in the previous 6 months.

payment_delay_days.description: Number of days customer payments or invoice settlements were overdue.

subscription_type.description: Account tier of the customer: Basic, Standard, or Premium.

contract_type.description: Agreement duration structure: Month-to-Month, One-Year, or Two-Year.

discount_used.description: Indicates whether the customer redeemed promotional coupons or discounts (0 = No, 1 = Yes).

last_login_days.description: Recency of last login in days before observation date.

churn.description: Target churn indicator: 0 = Customer Retained, 1 = Customer Churned.
